LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.1: Active listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Active listening, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What do you like about your family?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. name family members using appropriate titles as they refer to them,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Active listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Active listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration speaking as the learner talks about family and listens to stories about family members.

• Self-efficacy: Knowing my family as the learner tells their relationship with the members of the family. (father, mother,

brother, sister).

Values:
• Respect is developed as the learner take turn in telling stories about family members

• Responsibility is developed as the learner role plays family members.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion is enhanced as the learner with others in class talk about family members and the strong relationships.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learners are involved in active listening so as to follow instructions and receive information in all learning areas.

Suggested learning resources: Charts showing pictures of family members.
